cards.label: Whitechapel
cards.text: A railway arch nobody's bothered to lock properly in three years. It's held ore the whole time and nothing's ever gone wrong with it, which is not the same as nothing ever going wrong with it.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That one's ours and it's soft as anything. Fine while nobody's looking twice at us. We're past that now."

choices.label: Fund a lookout (£150)
choices.result_text: You put the money where Nadia can actually spend it, not where it looks good spent. Somebody starts sitting on a crate near the arch most evenings, reading a paper, not reading a paper.

choices.label: Stay soft and fast
choices.result_text: You leave it as it is. Nobody's ever taken it before. That's an argument, not a guarantee.

cards.text: Either way, the arch keeps doing what it's always done, for now. Whether that keeps being true is a separate question.
